description_en: Queries a list of NAT CIDR blocks
description_zh: 调用ListNatIpCidrs接口查询NAT IP地址段列表
kebab_example: aliyun vpc list-nat-ip-cidrs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --nat-gateway-id ngw-gw8v16wgvtq26vh590000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNatIpCidrs

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPC NAT gateway to which the NAT CIDR blocks belong.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的NAT IP地址段所属VPC NAT网关的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the VPC NAT gateway whose NAT CIDR blocks you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询NAT IP地址段的VPC NAT网关的实例ID
parameters.name: nat_gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The NAT CIDR block to query
parameters.name: nat_ip_cidr

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run without querying the NAT CIDR block list. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing required parameters, invalid parameter values, and the authorization status of the RAM user. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.

false (default): sends a normal request, and the NAT CIDR block list is returned after the request passes the check with an HTTP 2xx status code
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会查询NAT IP地址段列表。检查项包括AccessKey是否有效、RAM用户的授权情况和是否填写了必需参数。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，会返回错误码DryRunOperation。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并查询NAT IP地址段列表
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses RequestId as ClientToken. The value of RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The status of the NAT CIDR block to query. Set the value to Available, which indicates that the NAT CIDR block is available
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的NAT IP地址段的状态。取值：Available，表示可用状态
parameters.name: nat_ip_cidr_status

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:
If this is the first request or no subsequent requests exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.
If a subsequent request exists, set the value to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The name of the NAT CIDR block to query. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的NAT IP地址段的名称。N取值为1~20
parameters.name: nat_ip_cidr_name

parameters.help_en: The NAT CIDR block to query. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的NAT IP地址段。N取值为1~20
parameters.name: nat_ip_cidrs

NatIpCidrs.description_en: The list of NAT CIDR blocks

items.description_en: The list of NAT CIDR blocks

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the NAT CIDR block was created
CreationTime.description_zh: NAT IP地址段的创建时间

IsDefault.description_en:
Indicates whether the NAT CIDR block is the default NAT CIDR block. Valid values:

true: The NAT CIDR block is the default NAT CIDR block.
false: The NAT CIDR block is not the default NAT CIDR block
IsDefault.description_zh:
是否为默认NAT IP地址段。取值：

true：是默认NAT IP地址段。
false：不是默认NAT IP地址段

NatGatewayId.description_en: The instance ID of the VPC NAT gateway to which the NAT CIDR block belongs
NatGatewayId.description_zh: NAT IP地址段所属的VPC NAT网关实例ID

NatIpCidrDescription.description_en: The description of the NAT CIDR block
NatIpCidrDescription.description_zh: NAT IP地址段的描述信息

NatIpCidrId.description_en: The instance ID of the NAT CIDR block

NatIpCidrName.description_en: The name of the NAT CIDR block

NatIpCidrStatus.description_en: The status of the NAT CIDR block. The value is Available, which indicates that the NAT CIDR block is available
NatIpCidrStatus.description_zh: NAT IP地址段的状态。取值：Available，表示可用状态

NextToken.description_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:
If NextToken is empty, no subsequent requests exist.
If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of NAT CIDR block entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的NAT IP地址段的列表条目数
